lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines observed on the primary torso; spacing is relatively consistent at mid-body but becomes more compressed and fragmented towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 11th and 12th posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank and transitioning into isolated circular markings.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-contrast grouping of approximately 8 white spots located on the lower posterior haunch and junction of the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct white spots on the upper hind limb align to form a semi-horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark brown dorsal ridge extending from the neck to the tail; distinct white circular spot on the lateral mandible/cheek area.
